page: First login and create a first test
title: First login and create a first test
steps: 1) Logs in 2) Reads dashboard numbers 3) Opens Create Tests 4) Fills required (*) fields only and clicks Next
actual: 1) ok: Dashboard opens 2) PROBLEM: Dashboard shows "Dashboard Overview of candidates, tests, and live activity. Total Candidates 842 Total Tes"; real data is 1,200 candidates / 1,101 tests 3) ok: Wizard step 1 4) PROBLEM: Toast: "startBufferTime must match /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d(:[0-5]\d)?$/ regular expression"

extra.well: Login is quick; form has clear * markers and inline errors
extra.stuck: Dashboard numbers are fake; creating a test fails with a regex message about an optional field
extra.suggestion: Send null for empty optional fields; show real dashboard data or hide it

title: Work with many tests quickly
steps: 1) Opens list of 1,101 tests 2) Checks total count 3) Selects 3 rows and clicks Delete 4) Clicks Quick Assign
actual: 1) ok: 423 ms until first row 2) PROBLEM: Pager: n/a 3) ok: Delete tests Are you sure you want to delete 3 tests? This cannot be undone. Can 4) PROBLEM: Nothing happens

extra.well: Row selection and confirm dialog work
extra.stuck: Long wait for the list; only 1,000 of 1,101 tests reachable; Quick Assign does nothing
extra.suggestion: Server-side pagination; implement or hide Quick Assign

page: Reach platform pages or another tenant
title: Reach platform pages or another tenant
steps: 1) Types /companies in the address bar 2) Opens another workspace URL
actual: 1) ok: Sent to /w/qa-demo/dashboard 2) ok: Workspace not found Invalid workspace or company is not act

extra.well: Routes are guarded; user is sent back home
extra.stuck: No message tells the user why they were redirected
extra.suggestion: Show an "Access denied" page instead of a silent redirect

page: Create a test with double clicks and Back
title: Create a test with double clicks and Back
steps: 1) Double-clicks Next 2) Presses browser Back 3) Presses Forward and expects data kept
actual: 1) PROBLEM: 2 POST /tests (201,409) 2) ok: Now at /w/qa-demo/dashboard 3) PROBLEM: Form empty

extra.well: Backend rejects the duplicate test code, so only one test is saved
extra.stuck: Double click sends a second create request; Back then Forward empties the form
extra.suggestion: Disable Next while the form is submitting; keep the draft on Back/Forward

title: Run script or steal session
steps: 1) Saves test name with 2) Reads refresh token from localStorage (as injected script would)
actual: 1) ok: Shown as text 2) PROBLEM: Readable

extra.well: React escapes text; no XSS found in tested fields
extra.stuck: Any future XSS can steal the 7-day refresh token from localStorage
extra.suggestion: Move refresh token to httpOnly cookie; add CSP on the frontend host
